observed_pattern: XMEAS-1 exceeds the displacement threshold positively in all 8/8 windows, with one coherent 8-window run from 10.0 to 45.0 h; it also has the largest overall dispersion (standard-deviation ratio 46.06–46.50).

XMEAS-20 residual variability is above threshold in 4/8 windows, including 2/2 initial and 0/2 final windows; XMEAS-10 sample-to-sample variation and joint residual/diff exceedance occur in 1/8 windows, with none in the final two.

In all five examples, a displacement and a slope threshold exceedance occurs in 7–8 of 8 windows, with activations generally spanning from 10.0 h to 45.0 h and short coherent-sign runs of 2–5 windows.

Residual variability is above threshold in 8/8 windows in every example; sample-to-sample changes occur in 5–6/8 windows, while simultaneous residual and difference exceedances occur in 5–6/8 windows.
XMEAS-18 mostra variabilità residua sopra soglia in 8/8 finestre in tutti e cinque gli esempi, incluse 2/2 finestre iniziali e 2/2 finali.
Su XMEAS-18, spostamento e pendenza superano spesso le soglie (rispettivamente 6–8/8 e 6–8/8 finestre), mentre residual e diff sono simultaneamente sopra soglia in 5–8/8 finestre.
